features.name: price__last
features.description: Last executed trade price for the current record.

features.name: price__bid
features.description: Best bid price (level 1) for the current record.

features.name: price__ask
features.description: Best ask price (level 1) for the current record.

features.name: price__mid
features.description: Mid price computed as the average of best bid and best ask.

features.name: ohlcv__open
features.description: First traded price observed within the current record.

features.name: ohlcv__high
features.description: Highest traded price observed within the current record.

features.name: ohlcv__low
features.description: Lowest traded price observed within the current record.

features.name: ohlcv__close
features.description: Last traded price observed within the current record.

features.name: volume__tick
features.description: Total traded volume within the current record.

features.name: trade_count
features.description: Number of executed trades within the current record.

features.name: volume__buy_sell_imbalance
features.description: Buyer-initiated volume minus seller-initiated volume for the record.

features.name: vwap__in_record
features.description: Volume-weighted average price across trades within the current record.

features.name: spread__l1
features.description: Level 1 bid-ask spread computed as best ask minus best bid.

features.name: tick_return
features.description: Return of the last trade price relative to the previous record's last price.

features.name: price__tick_direction
features.description: Direction of last trade move encoded as -1 (down), 0 (flat), or +1 (up).

features.name: return__bid_change
features.description: Relative change of best bid price versus the previous record.

features.name: return__ask_change
features.description: Relative change of best ask price versus the previous record.

features.name: return__mid_change
features.description: Relative change of mid price versus the previous record.

features.name: price__micro_volatility
features.description: Absolute tick return within the record as a micro-volatility proxy.

features.name: price__jump_flag
features.description: Binary flag indicating a sudden jump in mid-price within the record.

features.name: exec__slippage_estimate
features.description: Estimated execution slippage proxy derived from spread and depth.

features.name: price__micro_fair
features.description: Depth-weighted fair price proxy using bid/ask prices and sizes.

features.name: price__near_term_return_volatility
features.description: Absolute mid-price change within the record as a near-term volatility proxy.

features.name: price__imbalance_adjusted_return
features.description: Tick return scaled by buy/sell imbalance to account for order flow.

features.name: price__tick_sweep_flag
features.description: Binary flag indicating an aggressive liquidity sweep event.
